aura-guard.tagline: Gradient‑boosting forecasts improve on persistence by up to 30 % at the six‑hour horizon.
aura-guard.plain: The app delivers short‑term NO₂ forecasts for US monitors and a question‑answering agent that only returns numbers that can be traced to those forecasts.
aura-guard.summary: AURA‑GUARD combines a React front‑end with a Node API and a Python gradient‑boosting model trained on EPA hourly NO₂ data from twenty US monitors. The model is back‑tested with walk‑forward validation, achieving a 30 % MAE reduction over persistence at six‑hour ahead forecasts. The repository contains 99 source files, a CI workflow, nine test files and an LLM‑driven analyst that is constrained by a deterministic checker to ensure every numeric claim is grounded in the model output.
aura-guard.highlight: The difficult part was building a deterministic grounding checker that forces the LLM to cite only model‑derived values and to reject or correct answers about missing monitors, preventing untraceable or false statements.
